description: Assimetria Informational Website Template (product-template-informational) — feature manifest. Fork of the SaaS product-template whose front door is a content-driven single-page website (hero, about, services, team, testimonials, contact form + map) with an admin contact inbox. Inherited SaaS features remain listed below. Powers the Template Compliance Dashboard in Assimetria OS.

versioning.notes: Orkosi reads v* tags + the CHANGELOG section at each tag from templateRepo, compares with the customer repo VERSION and offers an upgrade; the merge applies `ownership` from the manifest at the target tag.

stack.frontend: React 18 + Webpack 5 + JavaScript + SCSS + Tailwind CSS + shadcn/ui + Lucide React
stack.auth: JWT RS256 sessions (httpOnly cookies, refresh tokens)
stack.database: PostgreSQL 15+ (migrations run once at container start)
stack.cache: Redis 7 (optional — rate limits, token blacklist, caching fall back to memory)
stack.hosting: AWS App Runner — one container (Express serves /api + built client) on port 3000, images in ECR
stack.cicd: GitHub Actions (ci.yml merge gate → deploy.yml on green main) with AWS CodeBuild equivalents (buildspec-ci.yml / buildspec-cd.yml)
stack.testing: Jest (client + server), Playwright E2E (Chromium by default), Docker smoke test in CI

features.name: Email/Password Authentication
features.description: JWT session auth with httpOnly cookie (7-day expiry). Login, register, logout, current-user endpoints. PrivateRoute guards authenticated pages. useAuth hook exposes session state. AuthPage handles both login and registration flows.

features.name: OAuth2 Social Login (Google + GitHub)
features.description: OAuth2 Authorization Code flow for Google and GitHub. No passport dependency — uses native fetch. Finds or creates users, links oauth_accounts table, issues same JWT cookie as email/password auth. OAuthButtons component renders provider buttons on the AuthPage.

features.name: Rate Limiting
features.description: Express rate limiting middleware with Redis-backed store (fallback to in-memory). General API rate limiter (100 req/min baseline DoS protection) applied to all /api routes. Endpoint-specific limiters for auth (login: 10/15min, register: 5/hr, password-reset: 5/hr, refresh: 30/min, oauth: 20/min), TOTP (setup: 5/hr, enable/disable: 5/10min), API keys (10/hr), uploads (20/min), AI (chat: 20/min, image: 5/hr), admin (read: 60/min, write: 10/min), and integration tests (10/min). All limiters return standard RateLimit-* headers and log warnings on threshold breach. Automatically disabled in test and development environments.

features.name: PostgreSQL Core Schema
features.description: Core tables: users (email, password_hash, role, timestamps), subscriptions (Stripe customer/subscription IDs, plan, status), sessions (token, user_id, expires_at). Migration runner executes @system then @custom migrations in order.

features.name: Authenticated App Shell
features.description: Post-login app shell with Sidebar navigation, Header, PageLayout wrapper, and HomePage as the main dashboard entry point. PrivateRoute enforces authentication on all /app/* routes.

features.name: Marketing Landing Page
features.description: Public landing page at / with hero section and CTA. Styled with Tailwind CSS + shadcn/ui. Includes AuthPage (/login, /register) and NotFoundPage (404 catch-all).

features.name: Features Section (Icon Grid)
features.description: Reusable FeaturesSection component with 6-item icon grid (2-col mobile, 3-col desktop). Accepts optional features, heading, and subheading props for per-product customisation. Default features cover the full @system stack: Webpack/React, Auth, Admin, Stripe, PostgreSQL, Docker.

features.name: Stripe Checkout Flow
features.description: Full Stripe checkout flow: checkout session creation (with optional trial days), customer portal redirect, cancel/uncancel subscription, webhook handler (checkout.session.completed, customer.subscription.updated/deleted, invoice.payment_failed/succeeded), DB sync, /subscriptions/plans endpoint (live Stripe prices), BillingPage (authenticated), PricingPage (public).

features.name: Docker + AWS App Runner Deployment
features.description: Multi-stage Dockerfile (node:22-alpine; client build → non-root Express runtime with tini, HEALTHCHECK on /api/health, OCI labels). start.sh validates the client build, derives missing secrets, injects brand/APP_URL/analytics placeholders, runs migrations exactly once (SKIP_STARTUP_MIGRATIONS) and boots degraded when the database is unreachable. docker-compose.yml = production-like local stack (app + PostgreSQL + Redis); docker-compose.local.yml = databases only for native dev.

features.name: Health Check Endpoints
features.description: GET /api/ping (liveness) and GET /api/health (status ok|degraded, db, auth, version, uptime). Always HTTP 200 so App Runner keeps the instance while the database is unavailable; degraded state is reported in the body for monitoring and the CI Docker smoke test.

features.name: CI/CD Pipeline (GitHub Actions + CodeBuild)
features.description: ci.yml: parallel lint / client tests / server tests / production build / Docker smoke jobs feeding an aggregate `ci` status check (the branch-protection context Orkosi applies to main). deploy.yml: runs only after CI succeeds on main (workflow_run) — Docker build with layer cache → ECR :sha + :latest → App Runner start-deployment → wait for RUNNING → public health check. e2e.yml: nightly/on-demand Playwright. buildspec-ci.yml / buildspec-cd.yml mirror the same steps for AWS CodeBuild.

features.name: Admin Panel API
features.description: Admin-only API endpoints for user management and system oversight. Role check middleware gates access to admin routes.

features.name: User Profile
features.description: GET /user and PATCH /user — fetch and update the authenticated user's own profile.

features.name: Transactional Email (Resend + SMTP + SES)
features.description: Multi-provider email service with pluggable adapters. Provider auto-detected from env vars (priority: Resend native API > SMTP relay > AWS SES > console fallback). Resend adapter uses REST API directly (no SDK, Node 18 fetch). SMTP adapter wraps nodemailer with connection pooling, TLS control, and Resend SMTP relay support. HTML templates (verification, welcome, password_reset, invitation, magic_link, notification) are inline-styled for email client compatibility. All sends tracked in email_logs table. Admin API: GET /api/email/provider, GET /api/email/verify, GET /api/email/quota (SES only), POST /api/email/test.

features.name: Notification Adapter (Slack + Discord + Console)
features.description: Unified notification adapter with pluggable backends. Abstracts Slack, Discord, and console logging behind a single interface. Provider auto-detected from env vars (priority: Slack > Discord > console fallback). Supports title, body, severity levels (info/warning/error), and metadata fields. Health check endpoints for monitoring adapter status.

features.name: Caching Layer
features.description: Cache abstraction that delegates to Redis (production) or NodeCache (in-process, no Redis required for dev). Transparent swap via env config.

features.name: Logging (Pino)
features.description: Pino logger singleton with pino-http request logging middleware. Structured JSON logs in production, pretty-print in development.

features.name: Error Handling
features.description: AppError class with standardised error codes and HTTP status mappings. Express error middleware converts AppErrors to JSON responses.

features.name: Scheduler / Cron Tasks
features.description: Cron-based scheduler that loads @system tasks (payment retries, subscription sync) and @custom tasks (product-specific jobs) from their respective index.js files.

features.name: Background Workers
features.description: Background job processor infrastructure. @system worker base + @custom worker extension point for queue consumers and async jobs.

features.name: Analytics Integration (placeholder)
features.description: PostHog or Google Analytics integration for page views, conversion events, and user behaviour tracking. To be added to client/src/app/lib/@system/.

features.name: Legal Pages + GDPR Compliance
features.description: Privacy Policy (/privacy), Terms of Service (/terms), Cookie Policy (/cookies) pages. GDPR-compliant cookie consent banner (CookieConsentBanner, Art. 6/7) with localStorage persistence. GDPR API: POST /api/gdpr/consent (Art. 7 consent recording), GET /api/gdpr/my-data (Art. 15 data export), DELETE /api/gdpr/my-data (Art. 17 data erasure). gdpr_consent_log table via migration 015.

features.name: Referral System (placeholder)
features.description: Referral code generation, tracking, and reward attribution. DB table + API endpoints + client UI.

features.name: Support Integration (placeholder)
features.description: Intercom or Crisp chat widget integration in client @system. Support ticket API if needed.

features.name: File Storage (placeholder)
features.description: AWS S3 or Cloudflare R2 integration for user file uploads. Signed URL generation, multipart upload support.

features.name: Test Infrastructure
features.description: Jest suites for the server (unit + supertest API tests with a mocked database) and the client (React Testing Library + snapshots). Both run as blocking CI jobs.

features.name: Playwright E2E Suite
features.description: Playwright specs for public pages, auth UI, navigation/404s, accessibility smoke checks and the brand/theme contract (brand.json → <title>, data-theme, --brand-primary, theme toggle). playwright.config.js boots the production build locally (scripts/e2e-server.js, degraded without a database); Chromium by default, all browsers with PLAYWRIGHT_ALL_BROWSERS=1. Runs nightly via .github/workflows/e2e.yml.

features.name: Analytics Dashboard Module
features.description: Reusable analytics components: AnalyticsDashboard, MetricCard, TimeSeriesChart, DataTable, DateRangePicker. Backend: AnalyticsRepo with time-bucketed queries, /api/analytics endpoints. Extracted from common pattern across 17+ products.

features.name: Team & Workspace Module
features.description: Multi-tenant workspace model with roles (owner/admin/editor/viewer). Invite flow, workspace switcher, RBAC middleware. Extracted from common pattern across 9+ products.

features.name: Search & Filter Module
features.description: SearchBar with debounce, FilterBar with dynamic chips, CommandPalette (Cmd+K), PostgreSQL full-text search helper, saved filters. Extracted from common pattern across 8+ products.

features.name: API Key Management Module
features.description: API key generation (prefix + hash), management UI, per-key rate limiting, request logging, apiKeyAuth middleware. Extracted from common pattern across 6+ products.

features.name: Embeddable Widget Module
features.description: Widget embed script generator (<1KB), iframe sandboxing with postMessage, customization API, CORS config, EmbedCodeGenerator component. Extracted from common pattern across 5+ products.

features.name: Webhook System Module
features.description: Outgoing webhooks with retry/backoff, incoming webhook verification, delivery logs, management UI. Extracted from common pattern across 5+ products.

features.name: Import/Export Module
features.description: CSV parser/generator (streaming), JSON export, background job for large exports, ImportWizard component, ExportButton. Extracted from common pattern across 6+ products.

features.name: Content-driven Informational Site
features.description: Single-page public website at / composed from one content file: navigation, hero, about, services, team, testimonials, contact section with API-key-free map embed. content/@system/site.js defaults deep-merged with content/@custom/site.js (objects merge, arrays replace); pages/static/@custom/SitePage delegates to the @system SitePage so products override composition without touching @system.

features.name: Contact Form + Admin Inbox
features.description: Public POST /api/contact (zod validation, honeypot, rate limit) stores submissions in contact_submissions and notifies CONTACT_NOTIFY_EMAIL (defaults to EMAIL_FROM). Admin-only inbox at /app/contact (Contact inbox sidebar entry) lists, reads and resolves submissions.

features.name: Imported Sites (Orkosi website cloner contract)
features.description: Sites cloned from an existing URL drop into client/src/app/pages/@custom/imported/<PascalName>/index.jsx (default-exported React components), styles into client/src/app/styles/@custom/imported/site.css and assets into client/public/imported/assets/ (copied to dist and served at /imported/assets/). Routes are registered in routes/@custom/index.jsx. See docs/INFORMATIONAL-SPEC.md section 6.

features.name: Feature-module switch (brand.json modules)
features.description: brand.json `modules` gates the inherited SaaS surface instead of deleting it (keeps @system merges from upstream working). Keys: billing, teams, selfRegistration, apiKeys, web3, ai, usage, onboarding, blog, webhooks — all false in this template, absent = enabled. One resolver per side with identical defaults: server reads brand.json at boot (MODULES_JSON env override), client gets the webpack __MODULES__ DefinePlugin constant. Drives router mounting (generated barrel mount()), migration skipping (not recorded), scheduler task refusal, CSP Stripe defaults, 403 on the three register endpoints, client route/sidebar/navbar/auth-page filtering.

rules.system: Template files shared across ALL products. Managed by Frederico. Synced automatically.
rules.custom: Product-specific files. Managed per-product. NEVER overwritten during template sync.
rules.sync: One-click sync updates ALL @system folders from the template GitHub repo. @custom folders are preserved.
rules.autoLoader: Entry points (index.jsx / index.js) auto-merge @system and @custom exports.

workflow: 2. For each @system folder: rsync --delete template/@system -> product/@system
4. Run npm install if package.json changed
